description: Revise a knowledge page, company profile, monitoring delta or delivery table without overstating cited sources. When a source describes a plan, is silent or conflicts with another entry, align tense to the dateline, match provenance labels and cite factual paragraphs without inferring absence. Not for official-document-verification.
